label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All _____ is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verse: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
note: The lead-in to the Great Commission — all power given, so 'go ye therefore' follows.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents _____ and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
verse: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
note: After the Temple dedication, everyone went home joyful and glad of heart.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The mountains _____ like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verse: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
note: When Israel came out of Egypt, the psalmist says the mountains skipped like rams and the hills like lambs.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be _____.
verse: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
note: Jonah's one-line sermon didn't even mention repenting — and the whole city repented anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But Martha was _____ about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verse: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
note: Martha 'was cumbered about much serving' — weighed down by the busywork — while Mary sat at Jesus' feet.
